idea.title: Notion template pack for French real-estate agents

source.text: A paid Notion template pack for French real-estate agents (agents immobiliers and independent mandataires) to manage leads, visits and mandates, 39 EUR one-off. Countries FR then BE. Budget 100 EUR, 5 hours a week, goal side income, no special edge. Just go: do not ask questions. Use the slug notion-real-estate.

idea.problem: French agents and independent mandataires need to track leads, visits and mandates
idea.customer: French agents immobiliers and independent mandataires (iad, SAFTI, Capifrance, eXp networks), then Belgian agents
idea.solution: A paid pack of Notion templates for leads, visits and mandates
assumptions: The 39 EUR price includes 20% French VAT
Sold through a merchant-of-record platform (Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy or Notion Marketplace) that collects VAT
The founder has no audience in real estate and no real-estate background
Channel not stated: assumed organic posts in agent communities, plus small paid ads within the 100 EUR budget

confidence.note: Competitor sales counts, FR search volumes and real-estate CPC are unknown; a sales count from any FR Notion seller would raise it

gross_margin.note: About 28.6 EUR kept of 39 EUR after VAT and Notion's 8% + 0.40 USD + 1% FX: 73% margin

ltv_cac.note: One-off sale: LTV 28.6 EUR vs paid CAC ~50 EUR (1 EUR CPC / 2% conversion) = 0.57

pricing_power.note: Free Notion CRM templates exist and a French mandataire CRM template sells at 19 EUR

build_effort.note: A Notion template is 1-2 weeks of work at 5 h/week, no code

skills_match.note: Notion skills are learnable; no real-estate know-how (registre des mandats, pige, compromis)

capital_needed.note: Gumroad and Notion Marketplace charge no monthly fee; 100 EUR covers it

time_to_mvp.note: Sellable in 2-3 weeks on Gumroad; Notion Marketplace review may take months

sales_cycle.note: 39 EUR is an impulse buy for an individual agent, no committee

channel_readiness.note: No audience, no network contact; paid CAC above LTV (R5: no_distribution hit, max 2)

search_demand.note: 44,000 mandataires in France (end 2024) but no measured search volume for Notion real-estate templates

trend.note: Mandataire count fell 5% in 2024; only 4 of the top 10 networks still growing in H1 2026 (R5: max 2.5)

willingness_to_pay.note: Agents already pay 159-200 EUR/month network packs that bundle tools; templates sell at 7-45 USD

free_alternatives.note: Notion's own free CRM for real-estate agents does the core job (R1: no edge, max 1.5)

competitor_density.note: 20+ paid Notion real-estate templates, 3+ in French, plus Hektor at 8,500 agencies

differentiation.note: French language only; French templates already exist at 19-89 EUR (R1)

legal_regulatory.note: Cannot be sold as a Hoguet-compliant registre des mandats; prospect data sits in the US outside Enterprise

platform_dependency.note: 100% Notion-dependent; Marketplace lists in USD only and Notion may revise fees at any time

market_risk.note: Real estate is cyclical: 1,120 agency failures May 2023-Apr 2024, rebound in 2025

skills.note: No stated real-estate or template-selling track record

assets.note: No audience, list or network among agents

interest.note: Stated goal is side income, no domain passion

rules_applied.effect: no channel and LTV:CAC 0.57: total capped at 49 (43 already below)

tam.reasoning: 44,000 FR mandataires x 39 EUR one-off; agency agents not counted (count unknown)

sam.reasoning: TAM x 5% assumed Notion users among agents (Notion adoption among FR agents unknown)

som.reasoning: SAM x 1% year-1 share = 22 customers x 39 EUR

competitors_found.reasoning: ~17 Gumroad/Etsy/Payhip/Getly listings + 8 in Notion's official collection, minus overlap; plus Hektor, Apimo, Modelo CRMs

price.reasoning: Founder's stated price, one-off, assumed VAT-inclusive

expected_lifetime.reasoning: One pack, no upsell planned: 1 purchase per customer

cac.reasoning: CPC ~1 EUR (generic FR range 0.50-3 EUR) / 2% conversion = 50 EUR

ltv.reasoning: 39 EUR x 73% margin x 1 purchase = 28.6 EUR

payback_months.reasoning: One-off profit 28.6 EUR < CAC 50 EUR: a paid customer never pays back

break_even_customers_per_month.reasoning: Fixed costs 0, so break-even is 0; for a 500 EUR/month side income: 500 / 28.6 = 18 sales a month

time_to_first_revenue_weeks.reasoning: 2-3 weeks to build at 5 h/week + 1-2 weeks of community posting before the first sale

tam.reasoning: 10,922 IPI professionals (end 2024) x 39 EUR; Flemish agents need a Dutch version

verdict.launch_reason: France has about 4x more agents than Belgium (44,000 mandataires vs 10,922 IPI professionals) and needs no translation.

type_checks.note: About 28.6 EUR of 39 EUR kept per order after VAT and Notion fees (73%); before ads, margin is not the problem
No shipping; Notion Marketplace grants refunds within 14 days, refund rate for templates unknown

verdict.cheapest_test: Gumroad pre-order page at 39 EUR, posted in 5 mandataire Facebook/LinkedIn groups plus 30 DMs: 3 paid pre-orders in 7 days or archive it
kill_criteria: Fewer than 3 paid pre-orders at 39 EUR by day 7 -> archive
Fewer than 5 replies to 30 DMs to mandataires by day 5 -> archive
Fewer than 100 landing-page visits by day 7 -> the channel is dead, archive

rescue.change: Sell through network sponsors (parrains/team leaders at iad or SAFTI) who onboard new recruits, with a 30% affiliate cut
rescue.why: Fixes no_distribution and ltv_cac: CAC becomes 30% of the price, paid only on sale
rescue.requires: One sponsor who agrees to push it to their team

rescue.change: Turn it into a 99 EUR 'first 90 days' kit for new mandataires: prospecting scripts, pige routine and the Notion tracker
rescue.why: Lifts pricing_power and ltv_cac above 1 (LTV ~72 EUR vs CAC ~50 EUR); escapes the 19 EUR template anchor
rescue.requires: Real-estate know-how from interviews with 5+ working mandataires

narrative.answer: **NO-GO**. Free and 19 EUR French Notion CRMs already exist, so a 39 EUR one-off pack keeps 28.6 EUR while a paid buyer costs about 50 EUR. With no audience, there is **no channel** that pays back.
tldr: The product already exists: Notion gives a **free** real-estate CRM, and French templates sell at **19-89 EUR**.
One-off at 39 EUR leaves **28.6 EUR** per sale; paid acquisition costs about 50 EUR, so **LTV:CAC 0.57**.
The market shrank (mandataires **-5%** in 2024) and the founder has no audience or real-estate edge.
narrative.lesson: A cheap one-off digital product with no audience needs a free channel you already own; without it, unit economics never close.

key_findings.title: The product already exists for free
key_findings.detail: Notion's own gallery lists a **free** CRM for real-estate agents, and a French mandataire CRM template sells for **19 EUR** on Payhip.

key_findings.title: Each paid buyer loses money
key_findings.detail: At about 1 EUR per click and 2.3% conversion, a buyer costs **~50 EUR** against **28.6 EUR** kept per sale (estimate).

key_findings.title: A shrinking, tool-bundled market
key_findings.detail: Mandataires fell **5%** in 2024 and networks charge 159-200 EUR/month packs that already **bundle tools**.

narrative.recommendation: Archive the 39 EUR template pack. Run the 7-day pre-order test only if you can first find one network sponsor willing to push it to their recruits.
narrative.steelman: 44,000 mandataires are self-employed, many new and disorganised, and Notion templates cost nothing to build or host; a French-native, Hoguet-aware pack could sell in mandataire Facebook groups. The evidence: French versions already exist at 19-89 EUR with no visible sales counts, so language alone is not an edge.

premortem.cause: Nobody finds the page: posts in agent groups get no traction and 100 EUR of ads buys 2 sales at best.
premortem.early_signal: Fewer than 100 page visits and 0 sales after 2 weeks of posting

premortem.cause: Buyers pick Notion's free agent CRM or the 19 EUR French template instead.
premortem.early_signal: Comments asking 'why pay when the free one exists?' on 3+ posts

premortem.cause: Each sale nets 28.6 EUR, so 500 EUR/month needs 18 sales a month that 5 h/week cannot generate.
premortem.early_signal: Fewer than 3 sales in the first 30 days

changes.what: Notion Marketplace takes 8% + 0.40 USD and is merchant of record, but lists in USD only and review may take months
Notion AI bundled only into Business plans, so built-in AI can build a CRM from a prompt
Transaction rebound: SAFTI and iad revenue up ~30% in H1 2025, then only 4 of the top 10 networks growing in H1 2026
New Belgian IPI code of ethics in force, with a chapter on AI

why_now.note: Generic Notion templates are saturated and French real-estate versions already exist: the window has passed.

icp.who: New French independent mandataires (iad, SAFTI, Capifrance) in their first 12 months, working alone
where: Podcasts: Le Vestiaire de l'immobilier, MySweetImmo
icp.pays_for_today: Network pack 159-200 EUR/month with tools bundled (iad Premium 199.90 EUR TTC/month); agencies pay Hektor from 79 EUR HT/month
icp.budget: unknown; tight in year 1, when many earn little
icp.trigger: unknown (assumed: first mandates signed and leads piling up in a notebook)

customer.segment: French independent mandataires, then Belgian IPI agents
customer.pain: Tracking leads, visits and mandates across a phone, notebook and network software
customer.today: Network-bundled software, spreadsheets, free Notion templates, or Hektor/Apimo in agencies

use_cases.name: Kit sold via a network sponsor to recruits
use_cases.who_pays: The mandataire, sponsor takes a cut

free_alternative.evidence: Notion's official gallery has a free 'CRM for real estate agents'; Zoho CRM is free for 3 users.

strong_competitor.evidence: La Boite Immo (Hektor) serves about 8,500 independent agencies (2024-01); 3+ French Notion templates also sell at 19-89 EUR.

graveyard.evidence: Searched 'notion templates dead', Indie Hackers, Reddit: no named real-estate template seller found that quit; generic templates are called saturated.

no_distribution.evidence: No audience; paid CAC about 50 EUR (1 EUR CPC / 2% conversion) vs 28.6 EUR kept per sale; Notion Marketplace review may take months.

costs_eat_margin.evidence: Notion keeps 8% + 0.40 USD + 1% FX; after 20% VAT the founder keeps about 73% of 39 EUR.

weak_demand.evidence: Mandataire count fell an estimated 5% in 2024 (Xerfi); self-employed agents 'a fondu de 15%' in under a year (MoneyVox, 2024-06).

legal_platform_risk.evidence: 100% dependent on Notion, which 'may revise the Notion Fees at any time' and lists paid templates in USD only; cannot claim Hoguet registre compliance.

saturated_wave.evidence: 20+ paid Notion real-estate templates found (Gumroad, Etsy, Payhip), but launch dates are not visible, so 10+ in 12 months is not proven.

risks.risk: Marketing it as a registre des mandats: a Notion database is editable and not tamper-evident, and mandates must be numbered without gaps
risks.mitigation: Say 'suivi des mandats, ne remplace pas votre registre legal'

risks.risk: Buyers store prospect data in the US: EU hosting exists only on Notion Enterprise
risks.mitigation: Add a GDPR note; the agent stays data controller

risks.mitigation: Sell on Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy too

risks.risk: Template shared freely after the first sale (Gumroad duplicate links)
risks.mitigation: Notion Marketplace locks templates to the buyer's workspace
